_meta_itemized.notes: SAME DOCUMENT AS FILING 26742 - ONE MONEY EVENT PUBLISHED TWICE. The county's Financial Reports listing carries this identical Malena Stevens sheet under two ids: 26742 as an 'Appointment Report' and this id as her 'Primary' report. The two PDFs are byte-different (different sha256) and differ ONLY in the county's redaction marking, but they are the same three pages, the same cover figures (2,775.00 / 1,500.84 / 1,703.58) and the same 15 contribution + 6 expenditure lines. Each was transcribed from its own pages, and the two records agree line for line - which is why this record claims a cross-check, not a second money event. THE ROWS OF 26742 AND 27210 MUST NEVER BE SUMMED TOGETHER (already flagged in the module's CLAUDE.md at the cover-totals level; it now applies at row level too). REDACTED BY THE COUNTY, NOT LEFT EMPTY BY THE FILER: on p2 a black marker covers the street-NUMBER portion of 11 of the 15 ADDRESS cells, leaving the street name, city, state and zip legible; four PO-box rows are unmarked. This is the publisher's act - the byte-different 26742 copy of the very same page prints those numbers in full, so the same document exists in the county's own listing both redacted and unredacted. Either way the street portion is discarded AT READ TIME under the privacy rule and only donor_city / donor_state are stored; on this form variant the single ADDRESS cell carries city and state as printed text, so both are read values and neither is inferred from a zip. GEOMETRY - p2 IS DECLARED, p3 IS MEASURED. The redaction blocks register as horizontal rules, so rowbands.py returns a CONTAMINATED 58-band detection on p2 in which every data row is split into two half-bands (against a clean 37 bands on the same page of 26742). Rather than store a pointer to half a row, p2 uses a declared frame (y0=26.91, pitch=1.927, x=8.94, w=79.56) taken from the identical page's clean measurement and validated at BOTH ends: the frame's row 1 crops to '2/23/2026 | Megan McKenna | ... Park City, UT 84060 | $100.00' and its row 15 to '4/7/2026 | Frank Smith | ... Venice, FL 34285 | $250.00'. It also agrees with the contaminated bands that DID detect - the half-band pair 8+9 spans 26.89-28.82 against the frame's 26.91-28.84. p3 detects cleanly and its rows carry measured geometry. FILER-STYLE AMOUNTS kept as read: line C2 is written '$50' and line E2 '$276', both without cents. THE COVER'S BALANCE ROW DOES NOT FOLLOW FROM THE LEDGERS (2,775.00 - 1,500.84 = 1,274.16 against a stated ending balance of 1,703.58) - the filer's own cover arithmetic, published verbatim by this module and not recomputed here; both ledger sides close on their own printed totals regardless. ROTATED PAGES: every page carries /Rotate 270, so scripts/campaign_finance/make_snippet.py, which scales by the unrotated pdfinfo page size, lands at 77.3% of the intended y; the crops above were taken with y and h pre-multiplied by 792/612. The stored geometry is measured/declared against the RENDERED page and is correct.
